symptom: `mxcli exec -p app.mpr - <<'EOF' … EOF` fails with `Error reading file: open -: no such file or directory` — `-` is taken literally as a filename, so MDL cannot be piped or written as a heredoc and every ad-hoc script needs a temp file first
cause: `exec` (and `check`) called `os.ReadFile(path)` directly, with no case for the conventional stdin spelling
insight: One helper both commands share, so `check` gained the same spelling rather than only the reported one; `check` reports the source as `<stdin>` instead of a bare `-`. Verified live: a heredoc through `exec` and a pipe through `check` both run. Tests `cmd/mxcli/mdlsource_test.go`. mxcli-todo #5
